description: Holds the ordered lines of the end-credit sequence, including literal text, block type and typography, plus flags that assign each line to the full, short, first-DLC, or second-DLC credit variants.

Id.technical: FName row key serialized in FGameDataTableRow_Credit; exported keys follow CREDIT_<sequence>_<variant>. No C++ lookup by this name was identified, so its runtime selection behavior is unverified.

LineNumber.simple: Line or ordering number within a credit block.
LineNumber.technical: int32 serialized at retail offset 0x10 with constructor default 0. The export uses 1 for nearly every row and only a few 0/3 values, so it is not a unique global ordering index; exact consumption is not visible in the available source.

ContentType.simple: Kind of credit line (title, section, company, job, name, image, or blank space).
ContentType.technical: EGameCreditContentType (None=0, Title, Company, Section, Job, Name, Image, Space, Invalid=255) serialized at offset 0x14 with default None. The export uses Title, Section, Company, Job, Name, and Space; Space rows carry empty text. The enum is the only evidence for the category semantics because no consumer was found.

Justify.simple: Text alignment for the credit line.
Justify.technical: TEnumAsByte<ETextJustify::Type> serialized at offset 0x15; constructor default is Left. Exported rows use Center for titles/sections/spaces, Right for job labels, and Left for voice names. No widget code in the available source reads this field.

FontSize.simple: Point size override for the line.
FontSize.technical: int32 at offset 0x18, default 0 in the reconstructed constructor. Exported data uses -1 for 2539 of 2549 rows and 40 for the two opening title rows, consistent with -1 being an inherit/default sentinel; this interpretation is inferred from data, not from a consumer.

LineHeightPercentage.simple: Line-height multiplier applied to the credit text.
LineHeightPercentage.technical: float at offset 0x1C with constructor default 0.0f. Exported values include 0.0, 1.0, 1.01, and a large 100.0 used by Space rows; no source consumer confirms the exact unit or whether 0.0 means automatic spacing.

LetterSpacing.simple: Extra spacing between characters in the line.
LetterSpacing.technical: int32 at offset 0x20, default 0. Exported values include 0, negative -100 on right-justified job lines, and positive 856/1320 values on name lines; the unit is not established by any identified consumer.

Text.technical: FString at offset 0x28, default empty. Unlike most game tables this field holds final strings (including names, company names, and a title with an embedded newline) rather than a localization ID; exported Space rows have empty Text. No runtime formatter was identified.

IsMain.simple: Include this line in the standard (full) credits.
IsMain.technical: Boolean flag at runtime offset 0x38; layout verification ties it to a retail bit-set instruction. Default false in the reconstructed constructor. No data-table reader is present in the available source.

IsShort.simple: Include this line in the short credits variant.
IsShort.technical: Boolean flag at runtime offset 0x39 with a retail bit-set proof; default false. Exported rows flagged here include the opening title and spacing rows. No C++ consumer of the flag was identified.

IsDlc1.simple: Include this line in the first DLC credits variant.
IsDlc1.technical: Boolean flag at runtime offset 0x3A with a retail bit-set proof; default false. No C++ consumer of the flag was identified.

IsDlc2.simple: Include this line in the second DLC credits variant.
IsDlc2.technical: Boolean flag at runtime offset 0x3B with a retail bit-set proof; default false. No C++ consumer of the flag was identified.

notes: No identifiable C++ consumer of CreditDataTable or FGameDataTableRow_Credit exists in the available Source, and the table is not among the names registered in GameDataTableManager::LoadDataTable. UGameCreditWidget reconstructs four prebuilt UMG panels (default, short, DLC1, DLC2) and scrolls them, but does not fetch this table. Therefore the variant-flag effects above are inferred from names/exported data rather than proven runtime behavior.

The exported table has 2549 rows; the reconstruction's layout checks confirm the retail field offsets, and status records show the struct constructor as matched while its generated Copy body remains DIFF. This is a structural/layout caveat, not evidence of a gameplay consumer.
Only the exported retail table and partial Content are available; a script, editor tool, or unreconstructed consumer could still read the table. No Blueprint behavior is assumed.
Do not treat the export's field values as constraints on other localizations: only this single CreditDataTable snapshot is present, and its Text values are already resolved strings.

usages.detail: Declares the serialized row schema; this is the only direct source-level evidence for every field.
Static assertions pin the reconstructed fields to retail offsets 0x8..0x28.
Static assertions pin the four variant booleans to retail offsets 0x38..0x3B with runtime bit-set evidence.
Shows the reconstructed credit widget's variant selection among four prebuilt panels, but no table lookup; included to document the consumer limit, not as proof that this table drives it.
